'''Jellyfish''' were marine invertebrates composed of a bell-shaped jellylike exterior, with tentacles dangling from its innards.

==Jellyfish in the galaxy==
[[File:HydroidMedusa-SWE.png|thumb|right|150px|Hydroid Medusa, a type of jellyfish]]
Different types of jellyfish throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] were:
*[[Arkanian jellyfish]]
*[[Doshian jellyfish/Legends|Doshian jellyfish]]
*[[Unidentified jellyfish/Legends|Mon Calamarian jellyfish]]
*[[Hoth jellyfish|Icy jellyfish]] of Hoth
*[[Euryale]]<ref name="Peurs">{{CasusBelliCite|99|La somme de toutes les peurs}}</ref>
*[[Gorgone]]<ref name="Peurs" />
*[[Sthénos]]<ref name="Peurs" />

Various living organisms that had a visual resemblance to jellyfish:
*[[Cochlera]]
*[[Nalydian floating jellyfish|Nalydian jellyfish]]
*[[Floating jellyfish]]
*[[Cornelius Evazan/Legends|Evazan's]] [[Meduza]]
*[[Mikan|Jellyfish statues]]

Other uses for ''jellyfish'' include:
*[[Mika (planetoid)|Jellyfish Cove]]
